Vendored clang host compiler for reproducible CPrime build-speed experiments.

Source: an existing clang.exe of the same version on the machine that vendored
it, originally at C:\Luke\Src\Archive\surfer\clang.exe; recorded for provenance
only, and not a path any tool here reads.
Version: clang 12.0.0
Target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc

This binary is used only as an optional host compiler. It is not required for
normal self-hosted CPC builds.
